notes: WMEA hosts High School (grades 9-12) and Junior (grades 7-8, plus a grades 5-6 Youth Choir) All-State events. Auditions are recorded and submitted through OpusEvent; recordings are ranked by screening committees. IMPORTANT: at the retrieval date WMEA had not yet posted a 2026-27 (2027 All-State) information center — the site's Honor Group Information page and the '2026 WMEA ALL-STATE' center still described the 2025-26 cycle (auditions opened September 1, 2025; High School Band/Choir/Orchestra May 28-30, 2026 in Tacoma; Junior and Jazz ensembles at the February 2026 Yakima conference). All dates below are therefore labeled season 2025-26 and must NOT be relabeled 2026-27. Separately, WMEA's conference-proposals page does publish that the 2027 WMEA State Conference is February 11-14, 2027 in Yakima, but WMEA has not yet tied specific 2027 All-State choir dates to it. Note also that in 2025-26 the high school choirs did NOT meet in Yakima — only the Junior/Youth choirs and High School Jazz Choir did.

organization.name: Washington Music Educators Association
organization.description: WMEA has been a Federated Affiliate Member of the National Association for Music Education since 1937. It hosts the WMEA All-State honor groups, the WIAA/WMEA State Solo & Ensemble Contest, and an annual state conference.

requirements.title: Participating teacher must be an active WMEA/NAfME member
requirements.description: Participating teachers must be active members of WMEA/NAfME from the time of application through the time of WMEA All-State.

requirements.title: Recorded audition, teacher-verified, no enhancement
requirements.description: Either teachers or students may produce audition recordings. Students must submit recordings to the submitting teacher for verification before submission; once verified, recordings may not be returned to the student. Teachers and students may NOT electronically or otherwise enhance any recording beyond the actual recording session.

requirements.title: Screening committee ranking
requirements.description: Individual screening committee members listen to all recordings for a given section and rank the recordings in order of quality. Screening committees are members of WMEA unless the WMEA All-State manager waives the requirement for specific personnel.

fees.description: Each applicant is charged an application fee, which is NOT applied to later fees for those accepted. The WMEA Board establishes student fees; amounts are not published in the governing policy.
Accepted students pay a registration fee set by the WMEA Board; the amount is not published in the governing policy.
